title: Model-agnostic harness: local models and cloud providers
objective: Keep 'point me at a directory' working with no subscription (local models via opencode) while allowing paid providers (Kimi, Claude, OpenAI) when available, including opt-in automatic credential handoff into disposable VMs, with secrets kept out of the repo, workspace, seed and images.

acceptance_criteria.text: A default launch with no cloud credentials works against the host-side ollama/llamacpp API reached through the narrow guestfwd channel, exactly as the no-subscription path requires.

Provider configuration is generated by scripts/regen-configs for at least one cloud provider end to end, and documented for Kimi, Claude and OpenAI; adding a provider never requires hand-editing a generated file.

Cloud credentials, including saved OAuth accounts, are supplied at runtime from a host-only credential escrow or keychain and never baked into the image, cloud-init ISO, shared base image, workspace, or Git; git status is clean after a session and image/seed inspection finds no secrets.
A single config or environment switch selects local versus cloud without changing the workspace command; ./lab <dir> stays the same.
Cloud provider domains are added to the egress allowlist only for the selected provider, and removed when switching back to local.
Failure modes are actionable: missing key, egress denied and provider outage each give a clear message; local fallback is documented and needs no code change.
Tests cover config generation, secret non-persistence, one provider call (live or stubbed) and an egress-denied cloud call.

A documented VM configuration option controls credential forwarding with secure defaults: `off` imports nothing, `auto` imports every supported credential found in the host escrow, and an explicit provider list imports only named integrations. The configuration contains selectors/paths only, never secret values.

With forwarding enabled and a supported host credential available, a fresh disposable VM starts the agent already connected without another browser login or pasted key. OpenAI ChatGPT Plus is proven via OpenCode `auth export`/`auth import`; API-key providers such as Anthropic/Kimi use their supported runtime credential mechanism.

OpenCode's data directory is persisted outside the agent container's `/home/agent` tmpfs for the VM lifetime, and `lab-vm stop/down` securely exports refreshed OAuth state back to the host escrow atomically before deleting the overlay. A failed export does not silently destroy the last usable credential state.

Credential forwarding is provider-agnostic, auditable without logging secrets, uses the existing SSH control channel or an equivalent non-workspace channel, preserves mode 0600/0700, and exposes no broad host credential directory to the VM.

Fresh VM supports a currently supported non-device-code OpenCode ChatGPT browser OAuth login (including Sign in with ChatGPT/token-sharing if offered), not only legacy Codex device code: discover actual methods/version and callback location, open URL in host browser, route required callback across host→VM→agent/server using explicit loopback-only SSH/relay forwarding, verify auth list and one provider request. Repeat with device code unavailable; no API-key substitution or broad/LAN port exposure.

Human auth gate is planned and fed back through the engine before container/VM teardown: export existing login privately first; test browser callback success/cancellation/occupied port, egress denied, container recreation, VM deletion/re-import and refreshed token persistence. Record redacted results and exact version/method; never log URL state, codes or tokens.

needed: local default launch with no credentials
VM auth forwarding config matrix: off/auto/explicit provider list
fresh VM auto-connect with an exported OpenAI ChatGPT account
missing or malformed host escrow fails safely without exposing secret content
agent container restart retains OpenCode auth for the VM lifetime
VM down atomically saves refreshed OAuth state before overlay deletion
seed ISO/image/workspace/git scan confirms no credential material
provider selection imports only requested integrations

#45 browser auth human gate after #41 provisioning passes: list opencode auth methods/version without starting an unattended login; implement loopback-only callback transport to the actual server namespace, test provider login/call with device flow disabled, then persistence/teardown. Requires owner browser interaction; remain pending until observed.
cases: 2026-10-28 owner requirement: Codex device code may be removed; browser/non-device-code auth is a release gate, not an optional future fallback. docs/chatgpt-auth.md previously required headless and advised cancelling browser login; that guidance must be superseded. Automatic credential escrow/import/persistence is still NOT implemented.
